objective: Run the frozen rich-gold semantic treatment across all 16 seed cases for Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6-thinking.
finding: Both models recovered 100% of required evidence. Sonnet scored 74.44% worthiness-role accuracy, 94.05% temporal accuracy, and 79.44% admission accuracy over 15 scorable cases; Opus scored 67.71%, 87.78%, and 83.33% respectively over 16 scorable cases. Sonnet had one malformed TU-04 response at the 1024 output cap. Opus had 11 pre-inference RPM blocks that were replayed after a benchmark-only RPM limit increase.
decision: Treat Sonnet as stronger semantic-role/temporal candidate and Opus as stronger admission candidate, but do not declare a permanent winner. Run the same frozen treatment on the provisional Gemini Flash comparator before model selection.
next_step: Run ag/gemini-3.8-flash across the same 16 cases with the same 1024 output cap and frozen gold.
